disclosure: Source: Google Local Services Ads policy update, reported by Ignite Visibility, effective October 1, 2026

claims.text: Google is changing how it charges for Local Services Ads, with some missed calls becoming billable leads starting October 1, 2026
advertisers can be charged for missed calls during business hours if the caller stays on the line for more than 20 seconds, even if nobody answers
only 17% of service businesses answer a new lead within the first hour
answering within 5 minutes roughly doubles the close rate
framing the policy change as proof that missed-call costs were already present, just invisible
